scenario.topic: Choose a monitor setup for the home office

options.name: Dual 24-inch 1080p IPS Monitors
options.upside: Provides ample screen space for multitasking with consistent colors and wide viewing angles.
options.concern: May require frequent cable management and desk space is moderately used.

options.name: Single 32-inch 4K UHD Monitor
options.upside: High resolution offers detailed visuals and reduces the need for multiple screens.
options.concern: Larger size may dominate desk space and VA panel has narrower viewing angles.

options.name: Ultrawide 34-inch 3440x1440 Monitor
options.upside: Wide aspect ratio supports multitasking without bezels between screens.
options.concern: Ultrawide format may not be compatible with all video conferencing software layouts.

options.name: Dual 27-inch 1440p Monitors with Adjustable Stands
options.upside: Higher resolution and adjustable stands improve ergonomics and screen clarity.
options.concern: Takes up more desk space and requires calibration for color consistency.

shared_context: Two participants need to select a monitor setup for a home office that supports productivity and ergonomic comfort. The setup must fit a desk space of 60 inches wide and accommodate video conferencing and multitasking.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a graphic designer who values color accuracy and multitasking efficiency in her home office setup.
personas.private_goal: To maximize productivity with a setup that supports multiple simultaneous workflows and video calls.

A.reason_for: Dual 24-inch IPS monitors provide ample screen space with consistent colors and wide viewing angles, ideal for multitasking and video conferencing.

B.reason_against: Single large screen reduces multitasking flexibility and VA panel has narrower viewing angles.

C.reason_for: Ultrawide aspect ratio supports multitasking without bezels.
C.reason_against: May have compatibility issues with some video conferencing layouts.

D.reason_for: Higher resolution and adjustable stands improve ergonomics and screen clarity.
D.reason_against: Consumes more desk space and requires color calibration.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a software developer who prefers a clean, minimal desk setup with high-resolution visuals.
personas.private_goal: To have a single, high-resolution monitor that reduces clutter and supports detailed coding and video calls.

A.reason_against: Dual monitors increase desk clutter and cable management complexity.

B.reason_for: Single 32-inch 4K UHD monitor offers detailed visuals and reduces need for multiple screens, fitting a minimalist style.

C.reason_for: Ultrawide monitor supports multitasking without bezels and has good resolution.

D.reason_for: Higher resolution and adjustable stands improve ergonomics.
D.reason_against: Takes up more desk space and requires calibration.
